hotel.name: The Orchid
hotel.description: A premium urban hotel designed around comfortable stays, thoughtful hospitality, and convenient access to the city.

amenities.name: Wi-Fi
amenities.description: Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel.

amenities.name: Rooftop Swimming Pool
amenities.description: The rooftop swimming pool is available for registered hotel guests.

amenities.name: Fitness Centre
amenities.description: The fitness centre includes cardio and strength-training equipment.

amenities.name: Wellness & Spa
amenities.description: The wellness area offers a selection of relaxation treatments.

amenities.name: All-day Dining
amenities.description: The hotel's all-day dining restaurant serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

amenities.name: Parking
amenities.description: On-site parking is available for hotel guests.

breakfast.description: Breakfast is served daily at the All-day Dining Restaurant.
breakfast.inclusion_note: Breakfast inclusion depends on the selected room and rate plan.

cancellation.summary: Cancellation terms depend on the selected rate plan. Flexible rates may allow cancellation before the property's stated deadline, while promotional or non-refundable rates may have stricter conditions.

smoking.summary: The hotel operates as a non-smoking property. Smoking is not permitted inside guest rooms.

pets.summary: Pets are not permitted in guest rooms unless an exception is confirmed directly by the hotel.

children.summary: Children are welcome. Room suitability and additional guest arrangements depend on the room's maximum occupancy.

identification.summary: Guests are required to provide valid government-issued identification during check-in.

extra_bed.summary: Extra-bed availability depends on the selected room and occupancy rules and must be confirmed for the requested stay.

accessibility.summary: Accessible facilities and room suitability can vary by room type. Guests with specific accessibility requirements should confirm the required arrangement before booking.

airport_transfer.summary: Airport transfer assistance can be arranged subject to availability and applicable charges.

local_transport.summary: The concierge can assist guests with local transportation information.

faqs.question: What time is check-in?
faqs.answer: Check-in starts at 2:00 PM. Early check-in is subject to availability.

faqs.question: What time is check-out?
faqs.answer: Check-out is by 12:00 PM. Late check-out is subject to availability.

faqs.question: Does the hotel have a swimming pool?
faqs.answer: Yes. The hotel has a rooftop swimming pool that is open daily from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM.

faqs.question: Is Wi-Fi available?
faqs.answer: Yes. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel.

faqs.question: Does the hotel have parking?
faqs.answer: Yes. On-site parking is available for hotel guests.

faqs.question: Is breakfast included?
faqs.answer: Breakfast is available, but whether it is included depends on the selected room and rate plan.

faqs.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: Cancellation terms depend on the selected rate plan. Flexible and promotional rates may have different cancellation conditions.

faqs.question: Are pets allowed?
faqs.answer: Pets are not permitted in guest rooms unless an exception is confirmed directly by the hotel.

faqs.question: Is smoking allowed?
faqs.answer: The hotel is non-smoking, and smoking is not permitted inside guest rooms.

faqs.question: Are children allowed?
faqs.answer: Yes. Children are welcome. Room suitability depends on the maximum occupancy of the selected room.

faqs.question: Does the hotel have a gym?
faqs.answer: Yes. The fitness centre is open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

faqs.question: Does the hotel have a spa?
faqs.answer: Yes. The wellness and spa area is open from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM.

faqs.question: Does the hotel have a restaurant?
faqs.answer: Yes. The hotel has an all-day dining restaurant serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

faqs.question: Can you arrange an airport transfer?
faqs.answer: Airport transfer assistance can be arranged subject to availability and applicable charges.

faqs.question: What documents do I need for check-in?
faqs.answer: Guests are required to provide valid government-issued identification during check-in.
